question: To whom must the practitioner bow mentally from that position?
premises: The practitioner is in the prescribed position.
The chosen deity is the primary recipient of reverence.
The guardians of the directions are also included.
inference: Therefore the practitioner should bow mentally to one's own chosen deity and also to the guardians of the directions.
plain_english: One should bow mentally to one's own chosen deity and also to the guardians of the directions.
